_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#11. Upstream fsi_fp_mono_fs_ga_ga.4C.yaml (COUPALGO iter_monolithicfluidsplit) is built the way the entry prescribes: exactly 4 coordinates carry two node ids each — nodes 13,14,15,16 (fluid) duplicated as 17,18,19,20 (structure) — and the FSI coupling condition names both DSURFACEs. It exits 0 with 6 result tests CORRECT. Removing the structure side of DESIGN FSI COUPLING SURF CONDITIONS gives 'got 0 master nodes but 4 slave nodes for coupling' from coupling/src/adapter/4C_coupling_adapter.cpp line 69, i.e. the coupling operator counting zero interface nodes on one side; removing both sides gives 'No nodes in matching FSI interface. Empty FSI coupling condition?' from fsi/src/monolithic/4C_fsi_monolithic.cpp line 410. Both exit 1 and run no result tests at all, so the entry's alternative — that the simulation would quietly run uncoupled — does not happen, and its quoted 'no FSI interface nodes found' appears nowhere (CLAIMED_NO_FSI_INTERFACE_NODES_FOUND_TEXT=0). Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
